title: Tag Works
description: TagWorks adds craftable tags to Minecraft. Designed for 1.21.8 on Fabric, this mod is created more for fun than for serious production, keeping the classic gameplay without forcing updates to newer version
body:
**TagWorks adds craftable tags to Minecraft,**

making it easier to label and organize your items. Designed for 1.21.8 on Fabric, this mod is created more for fun than for serious production, keeping the classic gameplay without forcing updates to newer versions. Perfect for players who like a bit of organization with a touch of humor.
![Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a7c263fc9fe191b05a1eefe8f5383691bb9aef9.png)

_one piece of iron with a piece of paper in the center._
